summary: Practise workplace conflict assessment, mediation intake and agreement design. Explore the five-day course outline and enrol with TrainingCred.
lede: Workplace conflict resolution and mediation helps HR practitioners, team leaders and workplace mediators assess disputes and decide whether a structured mediation process fits. Participants practise diagnosing causes with conflict-analysis frameworks, conducting impartial intake and facilitative conversations, and shaping options into agreements with review steps. The course also introduces considerations for remote mediation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle workplace disagreements directly or guide others through a fair resolution process.
prerequisites: Useful preparation: familiarity with routine workplace conversations and the way your role refers or records employee concerns. The course assumes no prior formal mediation practice.
